identity.name: Pilot Type 20

case.bezel: no bezel — fixed brushed steel case with an oversized onion crown

identity.one_liner: A large, oversized-crown pilot's watch styled after 1930s cockpit instruments rather than one specific vintage Zenith reference.

narrative.story: Zenith's Pilot Type 20 line draws its design language from 1930s cockpit instruments and observation watches generally rather than reviving one specific vintage Zenith pilot reference — the oversized onion-shaped crown, black dial with large luminous numerals, and cathedral-style hands all come from period military aviation equipment. The line sits apart from Zenith's El Primero chronograph identity, running simpler time-only or GMT automatic movements in deliberately oversized cases.
narrative.collector_notes: Case sizes vary meaningfully across Pilot Type 20 sub-models (Extra Special, GMT, Chronograph); confirm the exact diameter before buying, since 'Pilot Type 20' alone does not specify one case size.
